description:
Validates a UBL 2.1 or UN/CEFACT CII invoice against the official validation
    artefacts of its profile: the XML Schema modules of the syntax and the compiled
    Schematron of EN 16931 and of the CIUS. The artefacts are not reimplemented here.
    They are carried as data in the validation packs of the repository, which this
    module packages and executes.
